title: When the Choir Wakes
author: Dominic Ishikawa
blurb: Silas Almeida, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
